intro: Two days after a $29.99 oil change, Miss Doris's dipstick was way over full, and there was a fresh spot under the car. Here are the 12 oil change mistakes I see every week, from the shop and from us: too much oil (foam), the old crush washer, the stripped drain plug, the double gasket, the dry filter gasket, the wrong oil, the light, driving hard, the counter upsells, the free top-off, the 3,000-mile sticker, the cap. And the 5-minute check that catches all of them. Episode 6 of "Miss Doris's Car".
